replacements.en:
Caption: "ROOM TO GROW"
Character & Object: open shears · emerald topiary. Gardener with a curved pink back bending in, both hands on big cobalt shears around one leafy tip.
Gesture & Emotion: bending in, both hands on big cobalt shears around one leafy tip.
Shape Idea: the crescent back answers the hedge's curling crown; the open blades cut a white gap between them.
replacements.zh-CN:
短句："ROOM TO GROW"
人物与物件：张开的剪刀 · 祖母绿造型绿篱。一位园丁弯曲着粉色后背，俯身用双手握住巨大的钴蓝色剪刀，围住一处叶尖。
姿态与情绪：俯身，双手握住巨大的钴蓝色剪刀，围住一处叶尖。
形态构思：新月形的后背呼应绿篱卷曲的树冠；张开的刀刃在两者之间切出一道白色空隙。

replacements.en:
Caption: "FOLLOW THE FLOW"
Character & Object: blue S-ribbon · weightless glide. Freediver in a pink suit and emerald fins diving headfirst, arms together, weaving through one broad cobalt curve.
Gesture & Emotion: diving headfirst, arms together, weaving through one broad cobalt curve.
Shape Idea: pink body and blue water ribbon interlace as two flowing lines.
replacements.zh-CN:
短句："FOLLOW THE FLOW"
人物与物件：蓝色 S 形水带 · 轻盈滑行。一位穿粉色泳装、戴祖母绿色脚蹼的自由潜水者头朝下潜入，双臂并拢，穿过一道宽阔的钴蓝色曲线。
姿态与情绪：头朝下潜入，双臂并拢，穿过一道宽阔的钴蓝色曲线。
形态构思：粉色身体与蓝色水带交织，形成两道流动的线条。

replacements.en:
Caption: "THINK AHEAD"
Character & Object: lifted knight · low emerald table. Chess player resting a cheek on one arm, the other huge pink hand lifting a sculptural cobalt knight off the table.
Gesture & Emotion: resting a cheek on one arm, the other huge pink hand lifting a sculptural cobalt knight off the table.
Shape Idea: the blue horse head is the focal point; a thin paper gap under its base marks the move.
replacements.zh-CN:
短句："THINK AHEAD"
人物与物件：提起的马棋子 · 低矮祖母绿桌面。一位棋手用一条手臂托着脸颊，另一只巨大的粉色手把雕塑般的钴蓝色马棋子从桌面提起。
姿态与情绪：用一条手臂托着脸颊，另一只巨大的粉色手把雕塑般的钴蓝色马棋子从桌面提起。
形态构思：蓝色马头是视觉焦点；棋子底座下方一道细窄的纸色空隙表现出这一步移动。

replacements.en:
Caption: "CARRY THE DAY"
Character & Object: stacked parcels · wide stride. Mover in a huge pink coat walking low under a cobalt, emerald and red box stack, one eye peeking around the side.
Gesture & Emotion: walking low under a cobalt, emerald and red box stack, one eye peeking around the side.
Shape Idea: square boxes against rounded back and bent legs.
replacements.zh-CN:
短句："CARRY THE DAY"
人物与物件：堆叠包裹 · 大步跨行。一位穿巨大粉色外套的搬运者压低身体行走，抱着钴蓝、祖母绿与红色箱子堆，一只眼睛从侧面探出。
姿态与情绪：压低身体行走，抱着钴蓝、祖母绿与红色箱子堆，一只眼睛从侧面探出。
形态构思：方形箱子与圆弧形后背、弯曲双腿形成对比。
